note: Optical dispersion library (`materials`) plus an RF/EO/conductor constants library (`library`, referenced from a sim config as `materials.<name>.library: <key>`). Every value carries the source actually read, its locator and condition. Values for which no accessible source could be read are listed under `missing`.
verification: Coefficients compared against the refractiveindex.info database entries (CC0) cited in `source` for each item; n(1550 nm) cross-check is in engine/tests/materials.test.mjs.

formulas.sellmeier_c_squared: n^2 = 1 + sum_i B_i lambda^2 / (lambda^2 - C_i^2), lambda in um; array `C` stores C_i (not squared)
formulas.sellmeier_c: n^2 = 1 + sum_i B_i lambda^2 / (lambda^2 - C_i), lambda in um; array `C` stores C_i (as used)
formulas.table: tabulated n(lambda); evaluated by 3-point Lagrange interpolation

Salzberg and Villa, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 47, 244-246 (1957); fit form by Tatian, Appl. Opt. 23, 4477-4485 (1984)

lithium_tantalate.description: LiTaO3, room temperature; tabulated data (no Sellmeier fit built in); dn/dlambda from 3-point interpolation of a 0.2 um grid, so group index carries an interpolation error

missing.barium_titanate: Only Wemple-DiDomenico-Camlibel single-term fits (valid 0.4-0.7 um) found; not valid at 1550 nm; BTO thin-film indices depend on growth. Provide n in the sim config with provenance.
missing.lithium_tantalate_sellmeier: No verified Sellmeier fit in hand; tabulated Bond data used instead.
missing.lithium_tantalate_rf_eo: RF permittivity and Pockels coefficients of LiTaO3 not entered: the only accessible table read (Zhu et al. 2021, Table 1) gives eps11,22 = 38.3, eps33 = 46.2 and r13 6.2, r22 0, r33 28.5, r51 8.4 without a clamped/unclamped condition or primary reference; not verifiable here.
missing.lithium_niobate_unclamped_rf_permittivit: No accessible source read for eps^T (constant stress) of LiNbO3.
missing.lithium_niobate_primary_sources: Weis and Gaylord, Appl. Phys. A 37, 191-203 (1985), doi:10.1007/BF00614817, could not be read (publisher login required, 2026-10-14); the LN RF and EO entries are therefore secondary_open_access. Replace with the primary table when a copy is available in references/.
missing.rf_loss_tangents: No loss tangent entered; tan_delta_rf stays a per-config sourced input.
missing.thin_film_gold: No thin-film gold conductivity entered; bulk 293 K value only.

library_schema.fields: eps_r (RF relative permittivity, crystal frame: number or {perp, par} with perp = eps11 = eps22, par = eps33), r_pm_per_v (named 3m Pockels coefficients, crystal frame, pm/V), conductor + sigma_Sm (S/m), dispersion (key of `materials` used for the optical index)
library_schema.entry: each field is {value, condition, source_read, locator, primary_cited, verification, verified_on}; verification is `primary` (the original data source was read), `secondary_open_access` (an accessible compilation was read; its primary reference was not read) or `secondary_vendor` (a manufacturer data sheet was read)
library_schema.override: config keys override library keys; eps_r {perp, par} and named r_pm_per_v coefficients merge one level deep

lithium_niobate_congruent.description: congruent LiNbO3, trigonal 3m, c = crystal z (axis 3)

eps_r.condition: clamped (constant strain), high-frequency response, as labelled in the source; temperature and frequency not stated
eps_r.source_read: D. Zhu, L. Shao, M. Yu, R. Cheng, B. Desiatov, C. J. Xin, Y. Hu, J. Holzgrafe, S. Ghosh, A. Shams-Ansari, E. Puma, N. Sinclair, C. Reimer, M. Zhang, M. Loncar, 'Integrated photonics on thin-film lithium niobate', Adv. Opt. Photon. 13, 242 (2021); read as arXiv:2102.11956
eps_r.locator: Table 1, LiNbO3 row, column 'RF dielectric Constant' (eps11,22 = 44, eps33 = 27.9, '(clamped, high-frequency response)'), arXiv PDF p.5, read from the rendered page image 2026-10-15; p.17 text: 'eps_r,z = 28 and eps_r,x/y = 44 for clamped, high-frequency response' (extracted text, 2026-10-15); p.19 repeats 28 / 44 without the clamped label
eps_r.primary_cited: not given for the table entries
eps_r.corroborated_by: same clamped values (eps11 44, eps33 27.9, 'clamped (v > 10 MHz)') in Crystal Technology, Inc. (an EPCOS company), 'Lithium Niobate optical crystals' data sheet DC-12 8/99, hosted at https://sphotonics.ru/LNmatProperties.pdf, p.2 (read 2026-10-15)

r_pm_per_v.condition: clamped (constant strain, high-frequency) experimental values; wavelength not stated in the compiling table. Caveat from the same source (p.3): the piezoelectric contribution 'was not entirely eliminated during the measurement of r51', and the clamped r51 'might be closer to the theoretical 14.94 pm/V'; r51 enters only shear (off-diagonal) terms, used by the vector overlap
r_pm_per_v.source_read: M. Veithen, X. Gonze, Ph. Ghosez, 'First-principles study of the electrooptic effect in ferroelectric oxides', arXiv:cond-mat/0311240v1 (2003)
r_pm_per_v.primary_cited: A. Rauber, in Current Topics in Materials Science, vol. 1, ed. E. Kaldis (North-Holland, 1978), p. 481 (ref. [22] of the source; not read)

r_pm_per_v_unclamped.condition: unclamped (constant stress, low-frequency) experimental values; wavelength not stated in the compiling table
r_pm_per_v_unclamped.source_read: M. Veithen, X. Gonze, Ph. Ghosez, 'First-principles study of the electrooptic effect in ferroelectric oxides', arXiv:cond-mat/0311240v1 (2003)

r_pm_per_v_unclamped.use: not applied by `library:`; copy into a config r_pm_per_v override with provenance when the unclamped condition applies
